worker_intro: Optional: a small service you run on a server, NAS or Raspberry Pi publishes your Instagram, Facebook and Threads posts on time even when this computer is off. It only receives publishing tokens and the posts you hand to it; no analytics, AI keys or app secrets.
worker_step_generate: Generate a shared secret and put the .env snippet on the machine that will run the worker.
worker_env_hint: Save this as .env next to docker-compose.yml:
worker_env_private: Keep this private. MetaDash stores the secret encrypted; the data key is shown only now and stays on the worker.
worker_step_run: Start the worker (see docs/worker.md for docker run, NAS and Raspberry Pi):
worker_tls_hint: Use HTTPS (Caddy profile) or a private network such as Tailscale/WireGuard when the worker is not on your LAN.
worker_step_connect: Enter the worker address and the secret (or paste a pairing string starting with mdw1:).
worker_secret_generated: Leave empty to use the generated secret
worker_no_public_media: No — posts need a media host from Settings → Publishing
worker_test_ok: Worker {version} answered in {ms} ms; the secret matches.
worker_disconnect_confirm: Delete every queued post and token on the worker and publish from this computer again?
worker_enabled: Sync with the worker every 2 minutes
worker_notify: Notify me when the worker cannot publish a post
worker_default_executor: New Meta posts are published by
worker_default_executor_hint: You can change it per post and account in the composer (Publish via).
worker_tokens_hint: Only publishing permissions are sent. Facebook gets the Page token, never your user token. Tokens are encrypted in transit and at rest.
worker_tokens_none: No tokens yet. Send one per account the worker should publish to.
worker_allow_broader_warn: A token with analytics, ads or messaging permissions gives the worker more access than it needs. Prefer a dedicated publishing token.
worker_recall_refused: The worker is already publishing this post, so it cannot be taken back.
worker_executor_refused: This target cannot be moved right now ({reason}).
